intended_object: The Galois module μ_n of n-th roots of unity of the separable closure, viewed as a ZMod n-linear representation of Gal(L/K) for a normal extension L/K embedded by σ into K^sep. This uses the fact that the action of G_K on μ_n factors through G_K / Gal(K^sep/σ(L)) ≅ Gal(L/K) when that subgroup acts trivially (i.e. μ_n ⊂ σ(L)). Inferred from the docstring and from its use in identifying μ_n(L) with μ_n(K^sep) as Gal(L/K)-representations.
explanation:
The body starts from the natural ZMod n-linear action of the absolute Galois group on `KummerCoeff K n`, which is Additive (rootsOfUnity n Kˢ). The hypothesis hN says the subgroup fixing σ(L) acts trivially, so the action descends to the quotient (`Representation.ofQuotient`). It is then pulled back along the isomorphism G_K/Fix(σ(L)) ≃ Gal(L/K). The lemma `kummerCoeffFiniteRepresentation_restrictNormalHom` confirms that τ = g|_L acts as g does, which is exactly the standard inflation/factoring of μ_n to a Gal(L/K)-module. 

The hypothesis hN is the condition needed for the action to descend, so it is not an extra restriction. Normality of L/K is needed for Gal(L/K) to be a quotient of G_K. ZMod n is the natural scalar ring for n-torsion. 

The construction is a specific object built from generic Mathlib pieces (`Representation.ofDistribMulAction`, `Representation.ofQuotient`), so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has no dedicated counterpart.
